entities.summary: People's Republic, a political institution in Mongolia during Bogd Khanate and Independence (1920–1924). Grew from Mongolian People's Republic proclaimed after the Bogd Khan's death and Declaration of Independence. Led to the emergence of Ungern-Sternberg and Revolution of 1921 and Sükhbaatar and Soviet forces liberate Urga from Ungern-Sternberg.
